name: Event Manager Widget for Elementor
author: Darshan Chauhan

sections.description:
Event Manager Widget for Elementor is a powerful plugin that helps you create, manage, and display events on your WordPress website. It provides a complete solution for event management with seamless integration with Elementor page builder.

Key Features:

  • Custom post type for events
  • Event categories taxonomy
  • Event meta fields (description, speakers, venue, etc.)
  • Elementor widget integration
  • Responsive event display
  • Customizable event layout
  • Event category support
  • Event description and speakers
  • User-friendly admin interface

Perfect for:
– Event organizers
– Conference organizers
– Meetup groups
– Webinar hosts
– Workshop organizers
– Any website that needs to display events

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.5 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Elementor Page Builder (required)

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/event-manager-elementor-widget directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Events > Add New to start adding your events.
  4. Use the Elementor widget to display your events on any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I add a new event?

Go to Events > Add New in your WordPress admin panel to create a new event. You can add event details like title, description, start/end time, venue, and speakers.

How can I display events on my site?

Use the Elementor widget to display events on your site. You can find it in the Elementor widgets panel under the “General” category.

Can I customize the event display?

Yes, you can customize the event display using the Elementor widget controls. You can choose which event details to show and how they are displayed.

How do I organize events into categories?

You can create event categories in the WordPress admin panel under Events > Categories. Then, when creating or editing an event, you can assign it to one or more categories.= How do I add a new event? =
